_comment: Hook lines for the Comedy Brew Eventfrog pages, written by script/eventfrog-content.ts. One hook per date: a line pinned under `dates` wins for that date; otherwise `hooks` is walked one line per week from the first night in 2022, so a page keeps its line and consecutive Thursdays never repeat (adding or reordering pool lines shifts future dates once). Each hook ends up as the title suffix after 'Comedy Brew, English Stand-Up: ' and as the first bold sentence of the description. Pool lines stay evergreen (no tonight, no weather, no weekday but Thursday); a pinned line may name the season or the long weekend, never a forecast, a price or a name. At most 29 characters (Eventfrog caps a title at 60 and the prefix takes 31), no full stop, and no city: Eventfrog appends 'in Zürich' to the title itself. `horizon` is the last Thursday script/eventfrog-dates.ts creates on Eventfrog. Edit freely; the next 09:20 run rewrites the pages that changed.
hooks: New in town? This is Thursday
Lost in town? Find your funny
The group chat needed a plan

dates.2027-05-06: Day off? Make a night of it
dates.2027-07-22: Still in town? So are we
